definitions: Attempting an impossible or overly ambitious task.
Undertaking a project that is too large, complex, or resource-intensive to be practical or successful.
examples: Trying to implement all features at once is boiling the ocean.
Their plan to redesign the entire system in a month is boiling the ocean.
We need to focus on key priorities, not boil the ocean.
synonyms: biting off more than you can chew
